selectedPrototypeFixture.role: Provides every historical signal actually used by this prototype (OL disruption, WR/TE and sack-free pass EPA for the receiver residual, RB rushing EPA, QB EPA/play).

otherComponentReferences.role: Production V149 2025 rolling-window component references (1-17 game windows, team-major). Includes QB pass-success-rate history (448 four-game and 32 full-season observations) and QB sack-free pass EPA, which this prototype does not use. Evidence that further component populations exist; one season only.

repositoryHistoricalLayers.missingFinalCanonicalGrades: No layer contains historical FINAL canonical grades. QB component histories (EPA/play, pass EPA, success rate) do not provide the five-component composite and do not reconstruct historical stabilization, opponent/pressure context, priors, recency or clamp state.

sourceOfHistoricalReference.derivedFrom: research/cycle7/inputs.json pins (nflverse 2024/2025 regular-season PBP and weekly player positions; committed derived fixture)
sourceOfHistoricalReference.form: game-level, one row per team-game, 17 games per team-season, with counts for exact pooling
sourceOfHistoricalReference.futureInformation: None within a window: a window uses only the games it covers. Position classification is full-season (Cycle 7 boundary).

seamInputQuantity: The seam consumes the final canonical grade (live grade blended with a regressed 2025 prior; QB adds recency and a clamp). No historical population of FINAL grades exists in the repository for any unit: replaying the current model on past seasons needs past priors, provider selections and context state that are not archived (Cycle 9 Section 6). Every prototype below therefore maps the unit's measured SIGNAL, not the final grade.

qbIndex.finalQuantity: qbIndex (five-component composite, opponent/pressure context, prior blend, recency, clamp)
qbIndex.perSeason: Fixture: 32 team-seasons x 17 games (EPA/play). V149 2025: success rate and pass EPA, 448 four-game and 32 full-season windows
qbIndex.forms: game-level -> rolling or stage windows, full season
qbIndex.mismatch: The prototype fixture gives EPA/play (2024-2025); V149 also holds 2025 pass-success-rate and sack-free pass-EPA windows (not used here). ANY/A, CPOE and the rushing bonus have no committed history, and the opponent/pressure context, prior, recency and clamp cannot be replayed.
qbIndex.stabilizationDiffers: Production stabilizes EPA toward the current mean (150 plays); the signal-layer reference is unstabilized.
qbIndex.verdict: PARTIAL: component-level prototype only; the displayed QB composite cannot honestly be given a historical standing yet.

olIndex.finalQuantity: olIndex (live = 2025 window percentile of disruption rate; blended with regressed legacy 2025 olIndex prior)
olIndex.mismatch: None at the signal layer (validated). The final grade adds a prior of a different construct.
olIndex.stabilizationDiffers: None (OL is unstabilized in production too).

receiverIndex.finalQuantity: receiverIndex (residual stabilized with 80 targets, centre-aligned, 2025 CDF, prior blend)
receiverIndex.identicalSemantics: residual construct yes; stabilization and centre alignment are not applied to the signal-layer reference or current value
receiverIndex.mismatch: Weekly-stat vs PBP aggregation of the same targets.
receiverIndex.stabilizationDiffers: Yes: production shrinks toward the current centre; the prototype maps the unshrunk 4-game residual against unshrunk 4-game windows (stage-matched).
receiverIndex.verdict: SUPPORTED at the signal layer (unstabilized residual).

rbIndex.finalQuantity: rbIndex (70% rushing + 30% residual receiving, stabilized, centre-aligned, LIVE_FITTED prior)
rbIndex.stabilizationDiffers: Yes (50 carries toward current mean in production).

defenseIndex.finalQuantity: defenseIndex (display-only soft-tail composite of coverage, pass rush, run defense and prevention, each a current-season rank or provider-dependent map)
defenseIndex.mismatch: Components are current-season ranks; prevention (points/drive) has no history in the fixture; pass rush is provider-dependent; the fixture run-defense signal is RB-only while production includes QB runs; coverage is 75% EPA + 25% CPOE ranks.
defenseIndex.verdict: NOT SUPPORTED: no historical population with current semantics.

defensiveSubunits.verdict: NOT PROTOTYPED. The fixture carries pass_rush, coverage and run_defense signals, but each differs from the production construct (provider, CPOE share, QB runs), and prevention has no history. Including them would test a different metric.
